bonus_text.en:
Rare Glyph 
Keeper
Radius Size: 3 
Grants +25.0% bonus to all Rare nodes within range.
Additional Bonus: 
You and your Companions deal 15% [x] increased Non-Physical damage.
Required (purchased in range): +25 Intelligence
Legendary Bonus: 
Increase Non-Physical damage by 0.5% [x] . 
Required: Legendary Upgrade (unlocks at Level 50)
